settings.monitor.enabled.label: Enable message monitoring
settings.monitor.enabled.hint: Read DingTalk personal messages at the polling interval. Turning this off stops new monitoring events.
settings.monitor.intervalSeconds.label: Poll interval
settings.monitor.intervalSeconds.hint: Seconds between pulls. Shorter intervals react faster but invoke the local dws more often.
settings.monitor.catchUpMinutes.label: Catch-up window
settings.monitor.catchUpMinutes.hint: How many minutes of messages to recover after startup or a disconnect. Set 0 to process new messages only.
settings.monitor.quietHours.enabled.hint: Pause proactive replies during the configured local-time window. Messages are still recorded.
settings.monitor.quietHours.start.label: Quiet hours start
settings.monitor.quietHours.end.label: Quiet hours end
settings.monitor.quietHours.end.hint: Local time in HH:mm format. The window may cross midnight.
settings.monitor.replyDuringQuiet.label: Reply during quiet hours
settings.monitor.replyDuringQuiet.hint: Off by default. When on, replies are sent immediately even inside the quiet window.
settings.monitor.paused.label: Pause monitoring
settings.monitor.paused.hint: Stop new monitoring and replies immediately without changing other settings.
settings.monitor.maxTargets.label: Target limit
settings.monitor.maxTargets.hint: Maximum number of enabled targets, a guard for local resources.
settings.targets.rows.label: Targets
settings.targets.rows.hint: Each row has a kind, ID, label, mention rule and reply mode. WS0 freezes the shape only; no real target is read.
settings.persona.name.label: Assistant name
settings.persona.name.hint: Name shown in message badges, the panel and the signature.
settings.persona.identity.label: Identity
settings.persona.identity.hint: Describe who the assistant is and whom it serves. Used as a system prompt for reply generation.
settings.persona.tone.label: Tone
settings.persona.tone.hint: Desired speaking style, such as "anime assistant" or "concise and professional".
settings.persona.language.label: Reply language
settings.persona.language.hint: Follow the incoming message automatically, or use Simplified Chinese or English.
settings.persona.signature.label: Signature
settings.persona.signature.hint: Short line appended to replies. Leave empty to omit it.
settings.persona.rules.label: Reply rules
settings.persona.rules.hint: Required behavior constraints, one per line. Rules cannot override safety settings.
settings.persona.knowledge.label: Background knowledge
settings.persona.knowledge.hint: Stable background material for replies. Do not store secrets or sensitive personal data.
settings.persona.samples.label: Sample replies
settings.persona.samples.hint: Examples of the desired voice, one per line, to align the model style.
settings.persona.allowEmoji.label: Allow emoji
settings.persona.allowEmoji.hint: When off, replies do not proactively use emoji.
settings.persona.maxReplyChars.label: Reply character limit
settings.persona.maxReplyChars.hint: Maximum characters per reply; longer output is truncated or regenerated.
settings.reply.autoReply.label: Automatic replies
settings.reply.autoReply.hint: When off, every reply needs manual confirmation in the panel.
settings.reply.allowedSenders.label: Allowed senders
settings.reply.allowedSenders.hint: Only these senders can trigger replies. Empty means no restriction.
settings.reply.blockedSenders.label: Blocked senders
settings.reply.blockedSenders.hint: Messages from these senders never trigger replies or tasks.
settings.reply.maxPerConversationPerHour: Caps how many replies one conversation can receive in an hour.
settings.reply.minGapSeconds.label: Minimum reply gap
settings.reply.minGapSeconds.hint: Minimum seconds between two replies in the same conversation.
settings.reply.ignoreBroadcast.label: Ignore broadcasts
settings.reply.ignoreBroadcast.hint: Ignore obvious broadcast or announcement messages to avoid accidental triggers.
settings.reply.requireMentionInGroups.hi: In group chats, respond only when the assistant is mentioned or its message is replied to.
settings.reply.ackOnTaskCapture.label: Acknowledge captured tasks
settings.reply.ackOnTaskCapture.hint: Send a short acknowledgement after capturing a task, stating that approval is pending.
settings.reply.declineOnReject.label: Explain rejections
settings.reply.declineOnReject.hint: Send a brief, polite note in the source conversation when a task is rejected.
settings.research.enabled.label: Enable research
settings.research.enabled.hint: Allow the assistant to use DSH web search to add facts before replying.
settings.research.onQuestionsOnly.label: Questions only
settings.research.onQuestionsOnly.hint: Run research only for explicit questions, avoiding extra latency in ordinary chat.
settings.research.maxResults.label: Search result limit
settings.research.maxResults.hint: Maximum number of sources used per search.
settings.research.timeoutMs.label: Research timeout
settings.research.timeoutMs.hint: Millisecond limit for one search. On timeout, reply without research results.
settings.research.includeCitations.label: Include citations
settings.research.includeCitations.hint: Keep source links in replies for verification.
settings.research.cacheMinutes.label: Search cache
settings.research.cacheMinutes.hint: Minutes to cache identical queries. 0 disables caching.
settings.tasks.enabled.label: Enable tasks
settings.tasks.enabled.hint: Allow explicit requests in messages to be captured as tasks.
settings.tasks.approvalTtlHours.label: Approval lifetime
settings.tasks.approvalTtlHours.hint: Pending approvals expire after this many hours and never execute.
settings.tasks.maxOpen.label: Open task limit
settings.tasks.maxOpen.hint: Maximum number of tasks that may be open at once.
settings.tasks.workspaceRoot.label: Workspace root
settings.tasks.workspaceRoot.hint: Directory root for task execution. Empty uses the DSH default workspace.
settings.tasks.permissionPreset.label: Permission preset
settings.tasks.permissionPreset.hint: Sandbox permission for task sessions. Dangerous access needs extra confirmation.
settings.tasks.timeoutMinutes.label: Task timeout
settings.tasks.timeoutMinutes.hint: Maximum minutes for one task execution.
settings.tasks.maxConcurrent.label: Concurrent tasks
settings.tasks.maxConcurrent.hint: Maximum number of tasks running at the same time.
settings.models.reply.provider.label: Reply provider
settings.models.reply.provider.hint: Empty uses the DSH default model provider.
settings.models.reply.model.label: Reply model
settings.models.reply.model.hint: Empty uses the DSH default model.
settings.models.reply.effort.label: Reply reasoning effort
settings.models.reply.effort.hint: Empty uses the model default reasoning effort.
settings.models.worker.provider.label: Worker provider
settings.models.worker.provider.hint: Empty uses the DSH default model provider.
settings.models.worker.model.label: Worker model
settings.models.worker.model.hint: Empty uses the DSH default model.
settings.models.worker.effort.label: Worker reasoning effort
settings.models.worker.effort.hint: Empty uses the model default reasoning effort.
settings.dws.binaryPath.label: dws executable
settings.dws.binaryPath.hint: Local dws command name or absolute path. Only the host channel starts it.
settings.dws.profile.label: dws profile
settings.dws.profile.hint: Profile passed to dws. Empty uses the dws default profile.
settings.dws.eventTtlHours.label: Event lifetime
settings.dws.eventTtlHours.hint: Hours received events are retained locally for deduplication and recovery.
settings.dws.restartBackoffMaxSeconds.hi: Maximum seconds of exponential backoff after dws exits unexpectedly.
settings.dws.debug.label: dws debug logs
settings.dws.debug.hint: Record dws process diagnostics. May contain message metadata; off by default.
settings.advanced.logLevel.label: Host log level
settings.advanced.logLevel.hint: Controls how much this plugin writes to the DSH log.
settings.advanced.auditRetentionDays.hin: Days local audit records are retained before cleanup.
settings.advanced.dryRun.label: Dry run
settings.advanced.dryRun.hint: Run decisions and task flow without sending any DingTalk message.
settings.advanced.debugPayloads.label: Log debug payloads
settings.advanced.debugPayloads.hint: Write message bodies to debug logs. May contain sensitive content; off by default.
